model.name: DistributedRamanFiber
model.propagator: in-house symmetric NumPy SSFM (never PyNLO path)
model.pump_model_detail: Depleted pumps are integrated with RK4 along z at 25 m steps; the signal is represented by its in-band total power at the channel-plan centre frequency. No pump-pump Raman transfer and no pump ASE.
model.signal_effects: loss + CD + Kerr retained; channel ISRS not modelled
model.ase: not included in this reference dataset (dra_ase_model='none')

fiber.alpha_model: flat; 1550 nm value of the SMF_100KM polynomial

nli_method: Per channel, fit one complex scalar a to NL ≈ a*LIN in the 64 GHz symbol-rate band, then take the band power of the residual NL-a*LIN as NLI. This removes the common phase/gain that a coherent receiver would equalize. nli_power_raw_w (no fit) is also recorded. out_linear uses the same pumps/loss/CD but n2=0.
notes: NLI analysis band is the symbol rate (64 GHz), not the 70.4 GHz occupied bandwidth.
Fibre alpha is flat at the 1550 nm polynomial value (0.162 dB/km); the SMF_100KM polynomial gives ~0.162-0.178 dB/km across C+L, so L-band edge loss is underestimated.
beta2 is flat -21.7 ps^2/km at 1550 nm; beta3=1e-4 ps^3/km is negligible over 64 GBd.
Depleted pump model uses the in-band total power at the plan centre frequency; it does not model pump-pump Raman transfer or pump ASE.
Each waveform is one 20261104 realisation; statistical uncertainty is documented in docs/dra-waveform.md and needs a second seed for a formal estimate.
step_artifact_500m_db = SNR(500 m) - SNR(generation step); negative means 500 m overestimates NLI.
